title: Audio Soundscape
description: A standing audio state for a place or a situation: what music plays, which ambience beds sit under it and how loud, which random one-shot layers run, and where the GM's bus faders should sit. Applied by the Sound Desk, by a cue, or automatically when a Scene carrying flags.blank-inheritance.audio.soundscape is activated. One file per soundscape in data/audio/soundscapes/, filename = id. Validated at load time by module/blank-inheritance/scripts/core/audio-director.mjs#validateSoundscape, which is the authority if these ever disagree.

title.description: What the GM sees on the desk.

note.description: Anything worth remembering about the pick.

music.description: Exactly one of pool/track/silence. Omit the whole field to leave whatever is playing alone — the right default for a soundscape that only describes a room.

pool.description: A music category id (a shuffle pool).

loop.description: For a named track. A theme usually loops; a piece of scored narration usually does not.

combat.description: What to play instead while a fight is running here. Restored to this soundscape's own music when the encounter ends.

ambience.description: Beds that run until something stops them. Each one's level is relative to the ambience bus.

track.description: An audio library asset id of kind ambience.

level.description: dB relative to the bed's normalised level.

scatter.description: Random one-shot layers — a dispatch call every twenty to sixty seconds, a distant explosion now and then. Timed on the GM's client, so every client hears the same clip at the same moment.

tracks.description: Fire-once asset ids; one is picked each time, never the same one twice running.

mix.description: Where the GM's own faders should sit while this soundscape is up. Applied when the soundscape is; the GM may move them afterwards.
